key.name: list_count
key.script: len([line for line in lines if line['order'] == order_id])

key.name: generator_count
key.script: sum(1 for line in lines if line['order'] == this.order_id)

key.name: largest_qty
key.script: max((line['qty'] for line in lines if line['order'] == order_id), default=0)

key.name: empty_count
key.script: sum(1 for line in lines if line['order'] == order_id + offset)

key.name: closest_qty
key.script: sorted([line['qty'] for line in lines], key=lambda qty: abs(qty - order_id))[0]

key.name: qty_total
key.script: sum({line['qty']: order_id for line in lines if line['order'] == order_id}.keys())

key.name: qty_set
key.script: str(sorted({line['qty'] for line in lines if line['order'] == order_id}))

key.name: pairs
key.script: sum(1 for line in lines for other in lines if line['order'] == other['order'] == order_id)

key.name: field_wins
key.script: sum(round for line in lines if line['order'] == order_id) == round * list_count

key.name: parent_count
key.script: sum(1 for line in parent.lines if line.order == parent.order_id)

key.name: root_count
key.script: len([line for line in root.lines if line.order == root.order_id])
